meta.name: Monitor competitor prices from Google Shopping via SearchApi with Google Sheets and Slack

name: Monitor Competitor Prices on Google Shopping with SearchApi (Google Sheets + Slack)

nodes.name: Schedule Daily
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 08:00. Change to hourly or weekly to check prices more or less often.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: The only node you normally edit. products = comma-separated list; add your own price per item with =PRICE (e.g. sony wh-1000xm5=300) to get undercut alerts. alert_pct / alert_abs = only alert when the typical price moves at least this % or $.

assignments.name: products
assignments.value: dyson v15 detect=800, ninja af101 air fryer=90, logitech mx master 3s=110, sony wh-1000xm5=300

nodes.name: Get Price History
nodes.notes: Reads the Latest tab (one row per product = last run's price and undercut state) so movement and new-undercut can be computed. Empty on the very first run (baseline).

nodes.name: Split Products
nodes.notes: Turns the product list into one item per product (name=PRICE lets you set your own price for undercut alerts).

nodes.name: Search Google Shopping
nodes.notes: Live Google Shopping offers via SearchApi.io. Runs once per product. condition=new asks SearchApi to return only new items (used/refurbished are also filtered downstream as a backstop).

nodes.name: Find Market Price
nodes.notes: Per product: median NEW price = typical_price, lowest legit offer = low_price/seller. Compares typical vs the last run, and if you set your own price (name=PRICE) flags undercut and how far below you the cheapest offer is.

nodes.name: Format Price Alert
nodes.notes: Builds the Slack Block Kit alert. Shows only products that moved beyond the threshold, were newly undercut, or are first-seen, and sets a notable flag so the Alert Gate can mute quiet days.

nodes.name: Alert Gate
nodes.notes: Only lets the Slack alert through when at least one product moved beyond the threshold or was newly undercut. On a quiet day nothing is posted.

nodes.name: Send to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts the Block Kit summary to a Slack channel. Connect your Slack credential and pick a channel. No Slack? Delete this node and read the Format Price Alert output.

nodes.name: Only With Price
nodes.notes: Only products that returned at least one priced offer get written to the sheet, keeping the history clean.

nodes.name: Append to History
nodes.notes: Appends this run's prices as new rows to the History tab (the growing log).

nodes.name: Update Latest
nodes.notes: Upserts one row per product (matched on product) into the Latest tab, so Latest is always the current-state dashboard.

parameters.content:
## Competitor Price Monitor (Google Shopping)

Track what the market charges for your products every day, and get pinged only when it matters: a competitor undercuts your price, or the going rate moves. Prices come from Google Shopping via SearchApi, history is logged to Google Sheets (Latest + History tabs), and a threshold-gated summary posts to Slack.

### How it works
1. Runs daily; reads products (with your optional price) and alert thresholds from Settings.
2. Loads last run's prices + undercut state from the Latest sheet tab.
3. Searches Google Shopping (new items only) for each product via SearchApi.
4. Takes the typical (median) new price and the lowest legit offer, computes the move vs last run, and flags competitor undercuts.
5. Posts to Slack only when something crosses your threshold or is newly undercut, and writes to the History (log) and Latest (dashboard) tabs.

### Setup
- [ ] Add your SearchApi credential to "Search Google Shopping" (free key at searchapi.io).
- [ ] In your Google Sheet, create two tabs, "History" and "Latest", each with headers: product, typical_price, low_price, low_seller, offers_count, your_price, undercut, gap_to_you, prev_price, change, pct, movement, url, checked_at. Select the sheet in "Get Price History" (reads Latest), "Append to History", and "Update Latest".
- [ ] Connect Slack in "Send to Slack" and pick a channel. No Slack? Delete that node.
- [ ] Edit Settings: products (use name=PRICE to track undercuts, e.g. sony wh-1000xm5=300), location, and alert_pct / alert_abs.
- [ ] Activate. The first run is a baseline; changes show from the second run.

### Customization tips
Tune alert_pct / alert_abs in Settings to change sensitivity. Used/refurbished are excluded (condition=new plus a code backstop). Latest is your at-a-glance dashboard; History is the full log.

## 1. Schedule & settings
Runs daily, then loads your products, prices and alert thresholds from the Settings node.

## 2. Read history & search Shopping
Reads last run's prices from the Latest tab, then searches Google Shopping (new items only) for each product via SearchApi.

## 3. Compare, alert & save
Find Market Price computes the typical price, the lowest offer, and undercut vs your price. Format + Alert Gate post to Slack only on notable moves. Prices are appended to History and upserted to Latest.
